run_lm_scoring: run the MALA language model to compute log-probability scores for text lines from an input file
run_lid_rerank: run language identification reranking using the MaLA-500 PEFT model on a list of text samples
run_multilingual_scoring: run multilingual text scoring with LLaMA-2-7b base model and MaLA-500 adapter via CLI
run_inference: run inference on text lines using the MaLA-LM model and write log-sum scores to an output file
run_gpu_inference: run GPU-accelerated language model inference on text data with optional CUDA device selection
